scope: Additive source/data resolution only. Historical qualification receipt and main importer adapter unchanged.
provenance_qualification: FBX Author and Revision metadata are empty. Its creator is Blender 4.3.1. Current source geometry and colour equality does not establish a historical author, commit or exact export invocation.

sidecar_declarations.app_qualification: Source association only; no runtime app binding was inspected or exercised.

source_data_comparison.method: Ordinary Python -B loaded the installed Blender pure-Python FBX parser without importing bpy. Only the existing box function and Server_Rack branch were evaluated as restricted pure cell data. FBX quads were decomposed into oriented, colour-labelled 10-unit exterior grid faces and compared with every exposed source voxel face. No mesh, model, render or export was generated.
source_data_comparison.palette_encoding: Current mesher uses q ** (1 / 2.2), then the Col byte layer quantizes to RGBA bytes. All four observed FBX colours match that current source encoding exactly.

measured_fbx_contract.creator: Blender (stable FBX IO) - 4.3.1 - 5.12.5
measured_fbx_contract.raw_geometry_bounds_units: Raw FBX coordinate units; not observed native centimetres.
measured_fbx_contract.pivot_qualification: Origin lies on the Z=0 bottom plane and centres the main cabinet body. The front-panel protrusions make the full raw bounding-box bottom centre [0,5,0]; the sidecar label is not an exact full-AABB-centre assertion.

units_resolution.evidence: Exact source/FBX face equality at 10 raw units per voxel plus sidecar voxel_cm=10. The catalog exporter independently rebuilds this recipe and divides its preview mesh vertices by 100 before Workbench rendering.
units_resolution.interpretation_qualification: Arithmetic interpretation of raw bounds times FBX UnitScaleFactor=100; this is not a native importer measurement.
units_resolution.existing_compensation_convention: Claude's voxel FBX route imports the large-coordinate mesh, preserves vertex colours and uses actor scale 0.01. The dedicated rack adapter must observe actual native asset bounds and apply compensation once, without silently multiplying an already-compensated import.

existing_route_evidence.material_source_contract: MaterialExpressionVertexColor to Base Color; roughness constant 0.9. Reuse requires actual read-only native path/class validation; do not create or modify a shared material through this source addendum.
existing_route_evidence.reuse_boundary: Reuse AssetImportTask/options/imported_object_paths and material-binding patterns only. Do not call import_island or place: their destinations and cell-clearing behaviour belong to the island lane.

source_view.observation: Small oblique source contact-sheet view shows a dark tall cabinet with projecting metal bays and green/amber accents, consistent with the measured recipe. The front is not shown as a full detailed acceptance view.
source_view.qualification: Regenerated Workbench VERTEX-colour source view; not a render of the retained FBX and not native appearance acceptance.

next_operation: Main operator prepares a dedicated pinned single-asset rack import with owned destination, material/vertex-colour preservation and expected-bounds readbacks. Import/save is a separate production operation; no world placement is granted here.
